body:
Design based on Neoforge.

Just a small data pack that changes Cobblemon pokemon types to correlate with my favorite rom hacks. Small changes are also given to their (and pre-evolutions') movepools to make the changes more viable. Many data pack changes were implemented based on Rangi42's "Pokemon Polished Crystal" rom hack and Nemo622's "Pokemon Emerald Seaglass" rom hack. 

Changes pokemon types include:

### Generation 1

- 006 Charizard: Fire/Dragon
- 012 Butterfree: Bug/Psychic
- 023 Ekans: Poison/Dark
- 024 Arbok: Poison/Dark
- 038 Ninetales: Fire/Ghost
- 047 Parasect: Bug/Ghost
- 055 Golduck: Water/Psychic
- 078 Rapidash: Fire/Fairy (v8)
- 083 Farfetch'd: Flying/Fighting
- 084 Doduo: Flying/Ground
- 085 Dodrio: Flying/Ground
- 097 Hypno: Psychic/Dark
- 137 Porygon: Normal/Electric

## Note: 
_If it does not initially work, drag or cut/copy and paste the downloaded datapack into the specific world's datapack folder. This step is unnecessary in some modpacks, but others are rather tempermental._
